## Experience

### Co-founder / Technical Founder — MetaTravelers
2021 – present
Built the digital launch system, pivoted to physical collectibles, and rebuilt operations AI-first for a two-person company.
- Built the launch system across smart contract work, a generative 3D asset pipeline, automated rendering, metadata, and delivery. The result sold out in 15 minutes.
- Shipped Legendari physical figures with design partners, factory QC, crowdfunding, and fulfillment across 22 countries.
- Rebuilt the company AI-first: agent orchestration, second brain, and human-reviewed workflows.

### Software Engineer, Full Stack — Allvue Systems
2017-03 – 2020-02
Full-stack engineering on private equity / fund accounting platforms after starting in application support.
- Built Cucumber UI testing coverage estimated to save ~800 manual QA hours per cycle.
- Worked across C#/.NET, TypeScript/JavaScript, Knockout, Python, MongoDB, and SQL.
